items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Jack T, everybody, the whole band. And we were going to... we all got together... without Pollack.

ctx.x: Oh, he didn't take it back?

No, he didn't. The manager wanted him to be a real hard, down to earth leader style you know. And so all the guys got down on him. Everybody was mad at him. Jack T, everybody, the whole band. And we were going to, what we were going to do was, actually we all got together and had a big meeting and we started to rehearse on our own without Pollack. We were going to call it Pollack's band without Pollack. (LAUGHTER).

So we started to go like that. We were going to do that. However, I happened to hear of a job at the Paramount Theater that they needed a saxophone clarinet player and I called up Benny right away and told him I heard that they needed... Rubinoff the violin player.
